notes.title: FERD - Regarding Update 0.5 - Big performance improvements
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!

We are excited to announce that we have released an update to FERD, which includes significant improvements to the game's performance and FPS. We have spent the past few weeks optimizing the graphics to improve the overall performance of the game, and we believe that the new update offers a much smoother and more enjoyable experience for players.

We invite you to try out the new update and share your thoughts with us. Your feedback is an essential part of our development process, and we will continue to work on improving the game based on your input.

For those of you with Nvidia RTX GPUs, we highly recommend enabling DLSS (super sampling) in the graphics options for even better performance.

Thank you for your support and we hope you enjoy the game!

Best regards,
FERD Team
